title: Lesson 16: Data Migration Strategy: ETL vs ELT, Tools, Validation, Cutover, and Rollback
description: The full migration lifecycle: ETL vs ELT, the Salesforce tool options (Data Import Wizard vs Data Loader vs enterprise ETL), dependency-ordered loading with external IDs, validation by record count and spot check, and the cutover and rollback plan that keeps a bad load from becoming a disaster.
